extraction.Name: Todd Harding Smith
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 13, 1920, by C. L. Lice
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Whittemore & Lewis Investment Co. for $1000; then Smith and wife conveyed the land by deed to W. H. Tackett for $3500, subject to the $1000 mortgage which Tackett assumed and agreed to pay
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739623 issued; Southwest quarter section 29, township 39, range 27; receipt for the patent was signed April 2, 1920, by the allottee; mortgage dated April 1, 1920; conveyance to W. H. Tackett dated September 18, 1920; Smith had a wife
